questions.q: Find the bug: 'repeat until score = 10' but score goes 9, 11 (it adds 2). What happens and how do you fix it?
questions.a: It never equals 10 so the loop never ends; use 'score > 9'.

questions.q: Complete your test plan, fix at least two bugs, save the final project; then take the 10-question unit quiz in the portal.

questions.q: Think again: If a program works once, does that mean it is bug-free?
questions.a: No: it must be tested with different inputs and situations.
